story_overview: Lin holds earnest conversations with Hae-won and Mei in ornate, traditional settings, at one point revealing a healed injury to their relief. While a man named Sheng is seen recovering in bed, tensions build in the Chairman's office where Hae-won, Kenji, and Mei are involved in a series of quiet, deliberate actions, culminating in a group meeting.

video_prompts:
Lin: Middle-aged man with short, dark hair, wearing a blue collared shirt and a dark blue Zhongshan suit jacket.
The Sunlit Parlor: Ornate residence living room interior with a geometric-patterned window, furnished with a vintage lamp and a bouquet of flowers.
the geometric lattice window screen: Dark wood window screen featuring an intricate, interlocking geometric lattice pattern.
Over-the-shoulder close-up in The Sunlit Parlor. Lin, wearing the dark blue zhongshan suit and the blue collared shirt, speaks with an earnest expression toward a woman who stands in the foreground with her back to the camera. Behind them is the intricate lattice of the geometric lattice window screen.

video_prompts:
Hae-won: Woman with dark hair tied back, wearing glasses and a long beige coat over a Traditional Green and Yellow Outfit.
The Tea Room: An indoor setting featuring a wooden screen.
the green and yellow hanbok: A traditional Korean hanbok consisting of a voluminous, floor-length emerald green silk skirt (chima) and a short, wrap-style canary yellow silk jacket (jeogori) tied with a long green ribbon, with delicate floral embroidery on the cuffs.
the wooden folding screen: Multi-paneled decorative folding screen made from dark, polished wood, featuring intricate geometric lattice work on the upper portion of each panel above solid lower sections.

Close-up on Hae-won, wearing her long beige coat over the green and yellow hanbok, in The Tea Room. A sad expression forms on her face as she listens to Lin speak, his back turned to the camera. The decorative wooden folding screen is in the background behind them.

video_prompts:
Mei: Woman wearing glasses and a colorful, light pink robe.
The Serene Bedroom: Traditionally decorated bedroom with a wooden sliding door.
the pink and blue silk robe: A woman's traditional multi-layered silk ensemble consisting of a short, vibrant pink jacket with wide sleeves over a long, flowing bright blue skirt, featuring an ornately embroidered floral chest panel in gold and green thread and a wide white sash tied in a bow.
the shoji sliding door: Traditional Japanese-style shoji sliding door with light-colored wooden latticework and translucent white paper panels.

Inside The Serene Bedroom, Lin stands before Mei and Hae-won, slowly bending his knee to show that it has healed. Mei, wearing a colorful, light pink robe, gasps softly and smiles with relief, while Hae-won looks on with a gentle, nodding smile. Lin and Mei exchange a warm smile before all three turn and exit the room through the shoji sliding door.
